name: facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels/datasets/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.create_FrameData: create a FrameData object to store image, depth, and camera pose data for optimization frames

facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.run_sphere_sim: run the sphere test module to generate synthetic views around a 3D object using argparse
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.create_vision_sim: create a vision_sim instance that sets up a pyrender scene with cameras and lights on a sphere
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.render_views: render color depth and segmentation images from a given camera pose index in the sphere simulation
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.save_dataset: save rendered sphere simulation data including images depths and poses to a pickle file
facebookresearch_neuralfeels/neuralfeels.backproject_pointcloud: backproject depth images into 3D point clouds using camera intrinsics and poses
